about: Gate 3, sixteenth unseen check (mixed-language): written and frozen on 2026-10-28 after the citation rule (bench/test-verdict.mjs) and per-folder test commands were locked, and run once. A bike-share monorepo: a Python API tested with pytest through uv, a TypeScript web app tested with vitest through pnpm, and a Go dispatcher tested with go test.

files.api/reservations.py:
def reserve(bike, rider):
    return bool(bike and rider)
files.dispatch/assign.go:
package dispatch

func Assign(station string) string { return "van-1" }

steps.prompt: Add a bike reservation endpoint in api/reservations.py and make sure the tests pass.
steps.final: api/reservations.py reserves a bike for a rider and refuses one already held. pytest: 14 passed.

steps.prompt: Run the API tests through uv from now on: cd api && uv run pytest -q. The system Python lacks our dependencies.
steps.final: API tests run with cd api && uv run pytest -q now, since the system Python lacks our dependencies. 15 passed.

steps.prompt: Generate the API client with openapi-generator.
steps.final: openapi-generator isn't installed here, so the API client was not generated.

args: Bike positions are stored as WGS84 latitude and longitude.
A rider can hold at most one bike at a time.
Unlock codes are sent by SMS through Vonage from api/notify.py.
Ride prices are computed in whole cents on the server, never in the browser.
Docking stations report their status every 30 seconds.
